investigation_notes.Description: The Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on a login page at https://www.vitalis-portal-security.com/login/auth, which is different from the legitimate brand domain (vitalis.com). The domain was registered two days ago through NameCheap and resolves to 195.178.110.15, and the page presents a patient portal login form consistent with credential harvesting. This is considered High Priority because a newly created lookalike site is using the brand logo to impersonate Vitalis Healthcare and is likely a phishing page targeting patient credentials, so escalation and takedown are warranted.
